_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for MASTERMIND phase criteria. Edit ONLY here. Run `pwsh -File scripts/render-phase-criteria.ps1` (or .sh) to regenerate the memory/13 §Phase definitions table. Consumed by: the phase-gate-reviewer skill (Steps 2 & 4), scripts/phase-gate-check.ps1/.sh (expected_artifact_paths + valid phase names), and /mm-template-audit (criteria-divergence check). JSON is used (not YAML) for dep-free parsing: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json is native; Bash uses python3.

phases.name: Idea
phases.purpose: The thing is a sentence or a paragraph
entry_criteria: A project brief skeleton exists (default starting phase on a fresh clone)
exit_criteria: memory/00-project-brief.md skeleton filled enough to start Discovery

phases.name: Discovery
entry_criteria: memory/00-project-brief.md exists with a stated problem and target user
exit_criteria: Problem, user and market validated through the 12-angle audit

phases.name: Definition
entry_criteria: Discovery validated: executive summary, personas, competitive analysis and known risks exist
exit_criteria: Architecture system map drafted and first ADRs accepted
Feature map populated with MVP slices

phases.name: Prototype
phases.skip_rule: UI projects only. Non-UI projects (backend services, CLIs, libraries, SDKs) may skip directly Definition -> MVP with a mandatory --skip-reason "no UI" recorded in memory/13-phase-history.md and memory/07-decisions-log.md.
phases.purpose: Iterative full-app design before committing to MVP build. v1 → feedback → v2 → … → freeze. Validates experience with stakeholders/users on a navigable artifact.
entry_criteria: PRD approved and MVP boundary set
exit_criteria: memory/14 §Changelog has a recent "Design frozen at vN" entry (< 30 days old)
Stakeholder sign-off recorded in the frozen iteration's feedback.md
memory/14 has no open decisions on tokens / components / patterns

phases.name: MVP
entry_criteria: PRD approved, MVP boundary set with one persona + one JTBD + one metric
If arriving from Prototype: final mockups frozen and design decisions closed
exit_criteria: All P0 features shipped to main
Testing strategy in place and feature-map MVP rows all Shipped
